summary.summary_zh: 本批核验并新增 47 篇期刊论文，全部待分类，47 篇摘要仍为空。23 篇依据 TMLR 官方已发表目录；24 篇依据出版社 DOI 登记元数据，其中 3 篇另有出版社页面佐证。日期精度保留来源原状：20 篇仅年份、24 篇到月份、3 篇到日。EMNLP 原缺作者的 980 篇已完成 DataCite 查询，补齐 24 篇作者及摘要，剩余 956 篇作者留空；预印本作者仍待正式论文集复核。OpenAlex 补查至 400/983 条缺字段记录后连续连接超时，唯一匹配没有可新增字段，未计入补全。
summary.summary_en: This batch added 47 journal papers, all pending classification and still missing abstracts: 23 from the official TMLR publication list and 24 from publisher DOI registrations (3 also checked on publisher pages). Source date precision is retained: 20 year-only, 24 month-level, 3 day-level. DataCite checked all 980 EMNLP records missing authors and filled 24 author lists and abstracts; 956 author lists remain blank. Preprint authors await final proceedings verification. OpenAlex stopped after 400/983 missing-field records due to repeated connection timeouts; its sole match added no fields.
